correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the two-parameter optimization from the frozen RESULT.md and source Remark 7.3: a=1-σ>0, x=√ε1, y=√ε2; on x+y≤2a the derivative of h(x)=x-x²+x⁴ is 1-2x+4x³>0 for x≤1/√2. On x+y≥2a, monotonicity of the exact product-test rejection R allows reduction to x+y=2a. With x=a+z,y=a-z the exact first-branch defect is 2z²(1-6a²-z²)>0 unless z=0 because a²≤1/8. This proves a unique symmetric maximum, and the improvement over Proposition 7.1 is a²(1-2a²)/4>0. Independently evaluated grid maxima for a=.08,.20,1/(2√2); finite grids corroborate but do not prove the continuum optimum.
